title: AI Nutritionist is Here! Afu Launches Dietary Function, Start Losing Weight with AI by Eating Smartly
excerpt: Health AI Ant A Fu's "Scientific Weight Loss 100 Million Catties" has made new progress! To help users eat healthily, Ant A Fu announced the upgrade and launch
content_html:
Health AI Ant A Fu's "Scientific Weight Loss 100 Million Catties" has made new progress! To help users eat healthily, Ant A Fu announced the upgrade and launch of the "AI Food Photo" feature on July 29. Users can let A Fu calculate the calories and nutritional information of food through photography, text, voice, and other methods, and receive suggestions for healthy diet combinations and exercise plans. They can also let A Fu record their dietary information directly into their health records, with flexible modifications and easy access to check if they have eaten too much or exercised too little, and where they might be hindering their progress.

In June this year, Ant A Fu officially launched the "Scientific Weight Loss 100 Million Catties" health initiative, with nearly 1.5 million netizens participating so far, successfully losing over 2.1 million catties. Diet is an important part of weight management. China's National Health "14th Five-Year Plan" also emphasizes implementing a rational diet action and a healthy weight management action, promoting widespread participation in reducing salt, oil, and sugar. This upgrade of A Fu's "AI Food Photo" function is expected to give everyone an "AI nutritionist," encouraging people to focus on proper diet and nutrition from daily life.

New Upgrade of the "AI Food Photo" Function! Netizens: Let A Fu Eat First From Now On

Journalists found that the newly upgraded "AI Food Photo" function of A Fu is very easy to use. Simply "take a photo, record, and modify" can easily complete the task. Taking a photo of breakfast and sending it to A Fu, the AI automatically identifies that the combination of "corn + tea egg + soy milk" is good, with calories controlled around 350 to 430 kilocalories. A Fu also recommends adding a tomato to supplement vitamin C, and drinking 200ml warm water half an hour after the meal. Although soy milk is a liquid, the amount of water the body can actually absorb is not as much as expected, and warm water can help the stomach digest the coarse fiber in corn.

In addition to taking photos of food directly with A Fu, users can also use text, voice, or combine with photos to trigger A Fu's "nutritional calculation card" to view total calories and nutrients such as carbohydrates, proteins, and fats. A Fu has a great memory; users can simply save the calories and nutritional results of each meal into their health records. The "diet record card" will then fully display past dietary information and remind users whether the calories consumed that day have exceeded limits. During the process of nutritional calculation and dietary recording, information such as the name, weight, and time of the food can be modified more accurately.

"In the past, I ate based on feeling, knowing that I should balance meat and vegetables, and reduce oil, salt, and sugar, but it was hard to evaluate exactly how much I had eaten. Manually recording was also difficult to maintain, which made it hard to succeed in losing weight." Chen, a Beijing worker, immediately used A Fu's food photo function. "It's like I opened a calorie account with A Fu, and the AI helps me see whether I've eaten too much or exercised too little. It tells me how to balance my nutrition better and what order to eat to digest easily without feeling tired. I plan to let A Fu eat first at every meal from now on."

Use AI to Control Your Eating and Get Moving, Millions of Netizens Have Lost Over 2.1 Million Catties

This year is the final year of the national "Weight Management Year." Rational diet and weight management are crucial for the health of every individual and are two key actions clearly outlined in the "14th Five-Year Plan for National Health."

At the end of June, the largest health AI in China, Ant A Fu, launched the "Scientific Weight Loss 100 Million Catties" health initiative through methods such as getting a body fat scale for one cent, upgrading AI-based diet and exercise solutions, and weight loss challenges, gradually becoming the preferred "AI weight loss companion" for the public. As of July 28, over one million users across the country participated in weight loss through the A Fu App, making themselves move more and eat better, with a total of 2.17 million catties lost.

content_html_zh:
健康AI蚂蚁阿福“科学减肥一亿斤”又有新进展！ 为了帮助用户健康饮食，蚂蚁阿福于7月29日宣布升级上线“AI美食拍照”功能。 用户可以让阿福通过拍照、文字、语音等方式计算食物的热量和营养信息，并接收健康饮食组合和运动计划的建议。 他们还可以让阿福将自己的饮食信息直接记录到健康记录中，灵活修改，轻松查看自己是否吃得太多或运动太少，以及哪些地方可能阻碍了自己的进步。

今年6月，蚂蚁阿福正式发起“科学减肥一亿斤”健康行动，至今已有近150万网友参与，成功减重超210万斤。 饮食是体重管理的重要组成部分。 我国国民健康“十四五”规划也强调实施合理饮食行动和健康体重管理行动，推动全民广泛参与减盐、减油、减糖。 阿福“AI美食照”功能的此次升级，有望让每个人都成为“AI营养师”，鼓励人们从日常生活中注重合理饮食和营养。

“AI美食照”功能全新升级！ 网友：以后让阿福先吃饭

记者发现，阿福全新升级的“AI美食拍照”功能非常好用。 只需“拍照、记录、修改”即可轻松完成任务。 拍下早餐照片并发送给阿福，AI自动识别出“玉米+茶叶蛋+豆浆”的搭配不错，热量控制在350到430大卡左右。 阿福还建议加一个西红柿补充维生素C，饭后半小时喝200ml温水。 豆浆虽然是液体，但人体实际能吸收的水分并没有想象中的多，而温水可以帮助胃消化玉米中的粗纤维。

除了直接用阿福拍摄食物照片外，用户还可以通过文字、语音或与照片结合，触发阿福的“营养计算卡”，查看总热量以及碳水化合物、蛋白质、脂肪等营养成分。 阿福记忆力极好；用户可以简单地将每顿饭的卡路里和营养结果保存到他们的健康记录中。 “饮食记录卡”将完整显示过去的饮食信息，并提醒用户当天摄入的热量是否超出限制。 在营养计算和膳食记录过程中，可以更准确地修改食物的名称、重量、时间等信息。

“以前我吃东西都是凭感觉，知道要荤素平衡，少油、少盐、少糖，但很难准确评估自己到底吃了多少。 手动记录也很难维持，导致减肥很难成功。” 北京工人陈某立即使用了阿福的美食拍照功能。 “就像我在阿福开设了一个卡路里账户，人工智能可以帮助我查看我是否吃得太多或运动太少。 它告诉我如何更好地平衡营养，吃什么顺序才能轻松消化而不感到疲倦。 我打算以后每顿饭都让阿福先吃。”

用AI控制饮食动起来，百万网友减重超210万斤

今年是全国“体重管理年”的最后一年。 合理膳食和体重管理对每个人的健康至关重要，也是《国民健康“十四五”规划》中明确提出的两项重点行动。

6月底，国内最大的健康AI蚂蚁阿芙通过一毛钱买体脂秤、升级AI饮食运动方案、减肥挑战等方式发起“科学减肥一亿斤”健康行动，逐渐成为大众首选的“AI减肥伴侣”。 截至7月28日，全国已有超百万用户通过阿福App参与减肥，让自己多运动、吃更好，累计减重217万斤。
